articles.title_original: A fish as old as Montana—the blue sucker discovered to live well over 100 years
articles.title_cn: 一条与蒙大拿州一样古老的鱼——蓝鲈鱼被发现能活超过130年
articles.excerpt_original: Using bomb radiocarbon dating on microscopic otoliths (earstones), researchers have found that a native species of fish in the Upper Missouri River in Montana is living up to 130 years—more than triple the previous estimate of around 40 years—and some blue suckers alive today hatched in the late 1800s, around the dawn of the automobile and when Montana officially became a state.

articles.excerpt_original: An international team of researchers is revealing the largest study to date detailing the wide range of insects, arachnids and other organisms that live in homes and other indoor environments across the United States and Canada. articles.excerpt_original: For decades, researchers have assumed male bumblebees' contribution to hives consisted mainly of DNA. However, a new study finds that the males actually help incubate baby bumbles, and that with males' assistance, hives thrive. The study, published in the Royal Society Open Science journal, quantifies the beneficial effects of having male babysitters in the hive.
articles.summary_cn: 几十年来，研究人员一直认为雄性熊蜂对蜂巢的贡献主要是提供DNA。然而，一项新的研究发现，雄性熊蜂实际上帮助孵化幼蜂，并且在有雄性照顾者的情况下，蜂巢能够茁壮成长。这项发表在《皇家学会开放科学》杂志上的研究量化了蜂巢中有雄性保姆的益处。

articles.title_original: A 3-million-year-old child just made human evolution far more complicated

articles.title_cn: 深海透明头鱼以惊人的4K画质捕捉到
articles.excerpt_original: Deep-sea researchers have captured stunning new footage of an extraordinarily rare fish with a transparent head and rotating eyes nearly 2,000 feet beneath the ocean's surface. Known as the barreleye fish, this bizarre creature uses its upward-pointing eyes to spot prey before rotating them forward to track its next meal, all while a transparent dome protects them.
articles.summary_cn: 深海研究人员在海洋表面以下近2000英尺的地方捕捉到了一种极其罕见的透明头鱼的新奇影像。这种被称为“酒杯眼鱼”的生物，利用其向上指向的眼睛在旋转它们以追踪下一顿美餐之前，先捕捉猎物，同时一个透明的穹顶保护着它们。

articles.title_original: Hidden ecosystem: Scientists discover 245 animals living inside a single deep-sea rock
articles.title_cn: 隐藏的生态系统：科学家在单个深海岩石中发现245种动物
articles.excerpt_original: Deep beneath the Pacific Ocean, scientists have discovered tiny hidden ecosystems inside metal-rich rocks that take millions of years to form. Researchers examined 244 nodules and found more than 4,100 animals living in their cracks and cavities, including unique communities unlike those in the surrounding seafloor mud. These remarkable miniature habitats could now be threatened by deep-sea mining for valuable metals
articles.summary_cn: 在太平洋深处，科学家在形成数百万年的富含金属的岩石中发现了微小的隐藏生态系统。研究人员检查了244个结块，发现超过4100种动物生活在它们的裂缝和洞穴中，包括与周围海底泥浆中不同的独特群落。这些非凡的微型栖息地现在可能受到深海采矿活动对有价金属的威胁。

articles.title_original: An ancient virus may help explain what makes the human brain different
articles.title_cn: 一种古老的病毒可能有助于解释人类大脑与众不同的原因
articles.excerpt_original: A virus that infected chimpanzees millions of years ago may have helped shape one of the most important differences between humans and our closest relatives: how our brains develop. Scientists at Lund University discovered that ancient viral DNA embedded in the chimpanzee genome switches off a gene called LINC00662, which remains active in humans and appears to play an important role in early brain development.
articles.summary_cn: 数百万年前感染黑猩猩的一种病毒可能帮助塑造了人类与其最接近的亲属之间最重要的差异之一：我们大脑的发展方式。隆德大学的科学家发现，嵌入在黑猩猩基因组中的古老病毒DNA会关闭一个名为LINC00662的基因，而这一基因在人类中保持活跃，并似乎在早期大脑发展中扮演着重要角色。

articles.title_original: Scientists discover a bizarre paradox among endangered penguins
articles.title_cn: 科学家发现濒危企鹅中的奇特悖论

While one population has remained stable for decades, another has declined by more than 40%, apparently due to a combination of predators, worsening storms, and changing ocean conditions. Even more surprisingly, the tiny Bounty Islands support nearly as many breeding pairs as the Antipodes Isla
articles.summary_cn: 一项开创性的无人机调查揭示了新西兰濒危的 erect-crested penguins 命运中的惊人分歧。虽然一个种群在几十年里保持稳定，另一个种群却下降了40%以上，这显然是由于捕食者、恶化的风暴和变化的海洋条件共同作用的结果。更令人惊讶的是，小型的 Bounty Islands 支持的繁殖对数几乎与 Antipodes Isla 相当。

articles.title_original: Dinosaurs may have been eating seaweed 100 million years ago
articles.title_cn: 恐龙可能在1亿年前就吃海藻
articles.excerpt_original: Dinosaurs may have been snacking on seaweed and other ocean foods more than 100 million years ago, according to surprising new evidence hidden in their fossilized teeth. Researchers discovered chemical signatures suggesting that coastal dinosaurs and other prehistoric animals relied partly on nutrients originating in the sea. The findings reveal that marine resources traveled through ancient food chains, supplementin
articles.summary_cn: 根据化石牙齿中隐藏的惊人新证据，恐龙可能在1亿多年前就吃海藻和其他海洋食物。研究人员发现了化学特征，表明沿海恐龙和其他史前动物部分依赖于海洋起源的营养物质。这些发现揭示了海洋资源通过古代食物链传播，补充了陆地食物来源。

articles.title_original: Crows can make decisions twice as fast as humans, scientists discover
articles.title_cn: 乌鸦的决策速度是人类的两倍，科学家发现
articles.excerpt_original: Crows may be even smarter than we thought, and their brains are astonishingly fast. Researchers at the University of Tübingen discovered that crows can make visual decisions twice as quickly as humans and monkeys, taking just 235 milliseconds on average to identify the direction of moving dots while maintaining remarkable accuracy.
articles.summary_cn: 研究人员在图宾根大学发现，乌鸦的智慧可能比我们想象的还要高，它们的脑部处理速度惊人。乌鸦在视觉决策方面的速度是人类和猴子的两倍，平均只需235毫秒就能准确识别移动光点的方向。

articles.title_cn: 一张新的宝藏地图揭示了地球失落史前生命可能隐藏的地方
articles.excerpt_original: A sweeping analysis of 540 million years of marine fossils has revealed surprising gaps in our understanding of Earth's ancient life. Scientists discovered that some of the greatest opportunities for finding previously unknown species lie in relatively recent geological periods, rather than the distant past. articles.title_original: A butterfly that fooled scientists for 200 years finally reveals its secrets
articles.title_cn: 一种欺骗科学家200年的蝴蝶终于揭示了它的秘密
articles.excerpt_original: Researchers have discovered that a familiar tropical butterfly actually belongs to three nearly identical species, including one previously unknown to science. Hidden ultraviolet wing patterns and DNA differences revealed the truth, leaving scientists puzzled about how the butterflies remain genetically separate despite living side by side.
articles.summary_cn: 研究人员发现，一种常见的热带蝴蝶实际上属于三个几乎相同的物种，其中包括一种科学上之前未知的物种。隐藏的紫外线翅膀图案和DNA差异揭示了真相，这让科学家们困惑于尽管这些蝴蝶生活在相邻的地方，它们是如何在基因上保持分离的。

articles.title_original: Scientists discover that necks didn't evolve for the reason we thought
articles.title_cn: 科学家发现颈部进化的原因并非我们所想
articles.excerpt_original: Scientists have discovered that the first animals to venture onto land nearly 380 million years ago had surprisingly stiff necks, overturning a long-standing theory about evolution. Rather than evolving to help animals turn their heads, necks may have emerged as part of the anatomical changes that allowed them to move using their front limbs.
articles.summary_cn: 科学家发现，大约3.8亿年前第一批登陆陆地的动物拥有出人意料的僵硬颈部，这一发现颠覆了关于进化的一个长期理论。颈部可能并非为了帮助动物转动头部而进化，而是作为允许它们使用前肢移动的解剖学变化的一部分而出现的。

articles.title_original: The mystery of how hair knows where to grow may finally be solved
articles.title_cn: 毛发生长之谜或将被解开
articles.excerpt_original: Scientists have discovered that the intricate patterns of hair follicles on mammals may arise from a remarkably simple process involving cells following chemical signals. The findings challenge a long-standing theory and reveal how nature can create complex biological patterns without a detailed blueprint.
articles.summary_cn: 科学家发现，哺乳动物毛囊的复杂模式可能源于一个非常简单的细胞跟随化学信号的过程。这一发现挑战了长期存在的理论，揭示了自然界如何在没有详细蓝图的情况下创造复杂的生物模式。

articles.title_original: Scientists discover why some mosquitoes love you and others don't
articles.title_cn: 科学家发现为什么有些蚊子喜欢一些人而不喜欢其他人
articles.excerpt_original: A surprising new study reveals that mosquitoes have very different tastes in humans, with each species attracted to its own combination of skin odors, chemicals, and bacteria. The discovery challenges the idea of a universal mosquito magnet and could lead to more effective repellents against dangerous disease-spreading mosquitoes.
articles.summary_cn: 一项令人惊讶的新研究表明，蚊子对人类的喜好差异很大，每种蚊子都被其自身的皮肤气味、化学物质和细菌组合所吸引。这一发现挑战了“通用蚊子磁铁”的观点，并可能导致更有效的针对危险疾病传播蚊子的驱蚊剂。

articles.title_original: Scientists discover a giant 66-pound rodent that lived 34 million years ago
articles.title_cn: 科学家发现一种生活在3400万年前的巨型啮齿动物
articles.excerpt_original: Scientists have uncovered fossils of a giant rodent that lived in Thailand 34 million years ago, revealing that enormous rodents evolved much earlier than previously thought. Named Yakamys sirindhornae, the ancient animal may have weighed around 66 pounds, roughly twice as much as other known rodents of its time.
articles.summary_cn: 科学家在泰国发现了生活在3400万年前的巨型啮齿动物化石，揭示了巨大的啮齿动物比之前认为的进化得更早。这种名为Yakamys sirindhornae的古代动物可能重约66磅，大约是当时其他已知啮齿动物的两倍。

articles.title_original: 237-million-year-old fossils reveal a bizarre armored sea amphibian
articles.title_cn: 2.37亿年前的化石揭示了奇特的装甲海洋两栖动物
articles.excerpt_original: A bizarre, heavily armored amphibian roamed the oceans 237 million years ago, despite the fact that modern amphibians cannot survive entirely in saltwater. Discovered in China, the giant salamander-sized creature may be the first known amphibian to have adapted to a fully marine existence.
articles.summary_cn: 尽管现代两栖动物无法完全在咸水中生存，但在2.37亿年前，一种奇特的装甲两栖动物在海洋中游荡。这种巨型蝾螈大小的生物在中国被发现，可能是已知第一种适应完全海洋生活的两栖动物。

articles.title_original: Paleontologists discover “one-in-a-million” fossil with 450-million-year-old soft tissue
articles.title_cn: 古生物学家发现含有4500万年古老软组织的“百万分之一”化石
articles.excerpt_original: Scientists have discovered a remarkably preserved 450-million-year-old fossil containing soft tissues from an ancient starfish relative, revealing unexpected details about marine life more than 200 million years before dinosaurs existed. Found in a museum collection, the extraordinarily rare specimen offers new clues about how Earth's earliest reef animals fed, survived, and evolved.
articles.summary_cn: 科学家们发现了一个保存异常完好的4500万年前的化石，其中包含古代海星亲缘关系的软组织，揭示了恐龙存在之前超过2亿年的海洋生物的意外细节。这个极其罕见的标本在博物馆收藏中发现，为地球最早期的珊瑚动物如何进食、生存和进化提供了新的线索。

articles.title_cn: 科学家发现橡子和莱姆病之间的惊人联系
articles.excerpt_original: After more than 35 years of research, scientists have uncovered surprising clues about what really drives Lyme disease risk. Contrary to longstanding assumptions, deer populations appear less important than mice, which can fuel a 40% increase in tick numbers the following year. Even acorn production can predict tick population surges two years in advance, while extreme temperatures may be far less deadly to ticks tha
articles.summary_cn: 经过35多年的研究，科学家们揭示了真正推动莱姆病风险的因素。与长期假设相反，鹿群似乎不如老鼠重要，老鼠可以导致次年蜱虫数量增加40%。甚至橡子产量可以提前两年预测蜱虫数量的激增，而极端温度可能对蜱虫的致命性远小于预期。

articles.title_original: Hidden climate superpower: Why some ocean “snow” carries six times more carbon
articles.title_cn: 隐藏的气候超级力量：为何某些海洋‘雪’携带六倍多的碳
articles.excerpt_original: Scientists have discovered that the stickiness of underwater “marine snow” plays a surprisingly important role in how much carbon reaches the deep ocean. Gooier particles resist bacterial breakdown and can transport more than six times as much carbon to the depths, revealing an unexpected connection between ocean slime and Earth's climate.
articles.summary_cn: 科学家们发现，水下‘海洋雪’的粘性在碳到达深海的过程中起着出人意料的重要作用。粘稠的颗粒抵抗细菌分解，可以将超过六倍的碳输送到深处，揭示了海洋粘液与地球气候之间意想不到的联系。

articles.title_cn: 一个充满巨型捕食者的古老海洋揭示了进化中的惊人转折
articles.excerpt_original: A remarkable fossil discovery in Colombia is challenging how scientists understand major evolutionary changes in Earth's history. Researchers uncovered an incredibly diverse ancient marine ecosystem where giant reptiles, sharks, and other creatures thrived as older evolutionary groups approached extinction and newer ones emerged. They call this previously unrecognized pattern a "Biotic Inflection," suggesting that ma
articles.summary_cn: 在哥伦比亚的一项惊人的化石发现挑战了科学家对地球历史上主要进化变化的认知。研究人员发现了一个极其多样化的古老海洋生态系统，其中巨型爬行动物、鲨鱼和其他生物在较老的进化群体走向灭绝和新的群体出现时繁盛。他们将这种之前未被认可的模式称为“生物转折”，暗示着生命在地球上的演化可能有一个新的理解。

articles.title_original: Ancient Siberian tomb reveals surprising secrets of cannabis use 2,800 years ago
articles.title_cn: 2800年前西伯利亚古墓揭示大麻使用的惊人秘密
articles.excerpt_original: Scientists investigating a 2,800-year-old Siberian tomb discovered roughly 1,000 cannabis seeds and chemical evidence suggesting ancient Scythians used the plant for its intoxicating effects. The remarkable find, surrounded by evidence of elaborate burial rituals and animal sacrifices, offers the oldest directly dated archaeological evidence of psychoactive cannabis use.
articles.summary_cn: 科学家们调查一座2800年前的西伯利亚古墓时，发现了大约1000颗大麻种子和化学证据，表明古代斯基泰人使用这种植物是为了其致幻效果。这一惊人的发现，周围有复杂的葬礼仪式和动物祭祀的证据，提供了有史以来最古老的、直接日期化的、关于致幻大麻使用的考古证据。

articles.title_original: Scientists just found dinosaur blood that survived 115 million years
articles.title_cn: 科学家们发现了11500万年前的恐龙血液
articles.excerpt_original: Scientists have discovered chemically confirmed traces of ancient blood inside 115-million-year-old dinosaur bones, challenging assumptions about how long biological molecules can survive. The extraordinary preservation could unlock new clues about dinosaur physiology and even help scientists search for ancient life elsewhere in the universe.
articles.summary_cn: 科学家们在一块11500万年前的恐龙骨骼中发现了化学上确认的古代血液痕迹，这挑战了关于生物分子可以存活多长时间的假设。这种非凡的保存状态可能为解开恐龙生理学的新线索提供帮助，甚至可能帮助科学家在宇宙的其他地方寻找古代生命。
